description: This file defines the 'CriteriaVisitor' interface for implementing the visitor pattern on search criteria objects within a query system, supporting logical operations like AND, OR, NOR, and other expression evaluations.

classes.name: CriteriaVisitor
classes.description: Interface for traversing and interpreting search criteria expressions, supporting logical combination operations and expression evaluation methods.

methods.name: visitAnd
methods.description: Applies logical AND to a list of criteria parts, returning the combined result.

methods.name: visitAnd (default)
methods.description: Default method that collects a Stream of criteria parts into a list and delegates to 'visitAnd'.

methods.name: visitAny
methods.description: Creates a criterion representing any (non-specific) condition.

methods.name: visitExists
methods.description: Creates a criterion to check if a specific field expression exists.

methods.name: visitField
methods.description: Creates a filtering criterion based on a field expression and predicate.

methods.name: visitNor
methods.description: Applies logical NOR to a list of criteria parts, returning the combined result.

methods.name: visitNor (default)
methods.description: Default method that collects a Stream of criteria parts into a list and delegates to 'visitNor'.

methods.name: visitOr
methods.description: Applies logical OR to a list of criteria parts, returning the combined result.

methods.name: visitOr (default)
methods.description: Default method that collects a Stream of criteria parts into a list and delegates to 'visitOr'.
